description: Inventaire des cavités et mouvements de terrain associés is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cartelie.application.i2. ATTENTION: cette carte ne peut plus être actualisée. Une cartographie provisoire est accessible: Suite aux deux études de recensement et d'analyse des mouvements de terrain réalisées par le Bureau de Recherche Géologique et Minière (BRGM) en 2002 et 2004 sur les arrondissements de Montdidier et Clermont puis de Compiègne et Péronne, la DDT de l'Oise ... Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Inventory of cavities and associated field movements" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Cartes interactives, Unités administratives, Géologie. The listing shows 2021-06-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
